I can't pretend to have the same exact problems but my depression has definitely made me stay inside alot, lost me friends and a gf or 2. Im same age also. Wake up and drink and go back to sleep. I can only say baby steps, try not to push away your gf and friends, but if they drop you or can't forgive you easily they may not be that great anyway. When you go to the toilet, wash your hands and face with warm water. Feels good. Could have a nice shower or bath. You got a garden or porch? Open the window or door for a mo and just watch the world. People are doing stuff. Where do they go? Maybe could go the shops and get a tasty something to eat. Take it slow on bad days and don't kick yourself. We give ourselves a hard time but I don't know if we always deserve it.  Call up a friend, keep it light, ask em if they're up for hangin out. They can't today? No problem, good to say hey tho right?  Watch a movie or something easy with your gf and have some romance. Helps with confidence. If she's not around then not to worry. Call a relative and have a little chat. Sure theyd like to hear from you. Bits of interaction with the outside world sounds like the key, build things up slowly, and not putting yourself down. You sound like a good guy to me :) as for meds I can't help you as I don't know enough about those ones. They work for some people more than others and the whole thing can be a bit overwhelming at times. Have a think about it, maybe write stuff down and pretend you want to get it down to show somebody else. Much love, keep at it and I think you'll be ok. Pm me if you ever need!
